agents.name: Workspace guide
agents.description: Suggests the next action and where to go in QA Studio or Automation Studio.

agents.name: Requirements analyst
agents.description: Turns a requirement into testable criteria and names what is missing.

agents.name: Test case designer
agents.description: Drafts manual test cases from criteria for human review.

agents.name: Automation author
agents.description: Proposes browser steps from QA instructions and observed controls.

agents.name: Coverage reviewer
agents.description: Maps existing cases to criteria and finds gaps and duplicates.

agents.name: Execution analyst
agents.description: Reads run results and evidence and suggests the next check.
